signup_month"}],"recommended_action":"NO_ACTION_NOISE","reasoning_summary":"Organic activation fell from 0.420664 in March to 0.394461 in April 2026, a 2.62 pp decline with p=0.0399, but April is not The decline is concentrated in Android (0.416082 to 0.386139), while email verification, KYC starts, document submission and KYC approval were stable, so the data does not localize a broken onboarding step. Monitor the next cohort and investigate Android activation separately rather than rolling back a release."}
